# Restarting the router

## Before you start

Check that the power adapter is plugged in. Note which lights are on.

## Steps

1. Unplug the power cable and wait 30 seconds.
2. Plug it back in.
3. Wait two minutes until the PON light stays green.

If the LOS light is red, the fibre may be cut. Contact support.
